fact_text: The SECP commissioner said overall demand in the Aug 2026 IPO round was 22 times the amount the issuers wanted to raise.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The SECP commissioner expected about 20 IPOs by the end of 2026, a view he tied to the momentum of the current IPO cycle.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner said the IPO pipeline for FY27 has 12 or 13 companies, drawn from sectors such as steel, fintech, AI and big retail brands.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner described IPO success as self-reinforcing: successful listings encourage more entrepreneurs to raise equity, and bigger companies and brands are expected to follow.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner argued that equity financing is cheaper and more transparent than debt, so healthy capital markets are critical for an economy that relies heavily on bank debt.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: SECP has allowed special purpose acquisition companies (SPACs), a popular listing product in global markets, which the commissioner said would give other companies an easier route to go public.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner said SECP applies no sector or size bias to listings; the key test is a good track record, with profitability, not the type of business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner said a company structured as a partnership and listed as a case study could skip the two-year waiting requirement, and expected other companies to follow the same route.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner said SECP's digitalised filings have made company registration easier, and new company registrations were said to be rising steadily.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: SECP, working with the CDC, is encouraging unlisted private companies to digitalise their shares, which would make a later move from private to public status easier.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner said SECP's digitalisation drive includes biometric and app-based processes, aimed at cutting the paperwork, compliance cost and documentation that deter investors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner said the SECP chairman also chairs the IFMP Institute for Financial Management, which is meant to deliver financial education alongside SECP's access reforms.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner's view: access to the market without financial education is not enough; combining access with education builds investor trust, which grows the number of investors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner cited about 600,000 people investing in Pakistan's stock market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner's aspiration was at least 2.5 million stock investors, with a potential of 20 million, if access and financial education improve trust.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner said Pakistani savings have long flowed into real estate, gold, crypto and Dubai property rather than the formal market, and SECP wants to bring that money into regulated markets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner cited third-party data that Pakistan is among the top five markets for Binance, with around 40 to 50 million Pakistanis using such digital products.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: A figure of 30 to 40 million crypto users, published by the government's crypto regulator, was cited; the commissioner said it was credible because the body is official.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner noted that digital payment platforms such as JazzCash and EasyPaisa are reported to have 40 to 70 million users, showing that digital access is wide.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner argued that unregulated crypto markets offer no investor protection, whereas a regulated stock market offers protection and safety, with returns that have been far superior.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner said the Pakistan stock market averaged about 18% returns over 20 years to 2026, beating gold, bank deposits and the dollar.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner said the Pakistan stock market was founded in 1949, before SECP itself was set up in 2000, so the market predates both the regulator and the current government.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner defined a successful capital market by higher trading volumes, broader investor participation, listings of all kinds of companies, and more products to trade.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner said foreign index inclusion needs a minimum trading volume, so reforms are sequenced: IPOs, domestic investors, liquidity and derivatives first, and foreign passive investors after.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: A speaker suggested Pakistan create infrastructure funds or trusts similar to REITs and list them on the market, which the commissioner said would also be positive for the market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)

fact_text: The commissioner said the scale of digital asset use signals strong demand to invest, so the regulator should open regulated routes for savers rather than close them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan Sustain Its IPO Success Momentum? | SECP Commissioner Ali Farid Khwaja | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-08-24)
